spoken_first_2s: एक दिन हलक ने सोचा हर चीज महंगी हो गई है। अब मैं एक का रेस्टोरेंट खोलूंगा।

notes.hook: AI-cartoon Hulk opens a ₹1 restaurant ('ek din Hulk ne socha...')
notes.what_goes_wrong: A magic spoon solves everything, so there is no real stake or payoff, and AI-cartoon versions of famous characters are a flooded format with no 'ye toh main hoon' moment.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: AI-cartoon stories of famous characters with a magic fix; nothing real is at stake.
